ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited (ABREL) announced the cessation of Mr. Ajay Kumar Gupta, CEO of its former Century Pulp and Paper (CPP) business division, effective September 16, 2026. This personnel change is a direct consequence of ABREL's previously communicated strategic sale of the entire CPP division to ITC Limited. The departure signifies the operational completion of a significant divestiture, aligning with ABREL's strategic shift and focus on its new real estate identity, with no immediate red flags evident as this is an expected outcome of a disclosed business realignment.
